Name: DE-Suppliers
Statement:
-- +CUSTOMFIELDS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Supplier)
select  s.Oid as DocumentOid,
        s.Oid as SupplierId,
		s.Name as Supplier,
		com.Name as Company,
        com.Id as CompanyId,
        d.Name as Division,
        d.Oid as DivisionId,
		dp.Name as Department,
        dp.Oid as DepartmentId,
		cr.Name as Currency,
        cr.Oid as CurrencyId,
        v.Oid as VatId,
		v.Name as Vat,
		s.ExternalId,
		s.Active as IsActive,
        pc.Oid as PaymentConditionId,
		pc.Name as PaymentCondition,
		s.Category,
		createdBy.Id as CreatedById,
        createdBy.Name as CreatedBy,
        modifiedBy.Id as ModifiedById,
        modifiedBy.Name as ModifiedBy,
        s.CreatedOnUtc,
		s.ModifiedOnUtc,
		s.Mail,
		s.Remarks,
		s.DiscountPercentage,
		s.VolumeDiscountPercentage,
		s.OtherCreditor,
		s.Street,
		s.TaxPayerNumber,
        depRelated.Name as RelatedDepartment,
        depRelated.Oid as RelatedDepartmentId,
        companyRelated.Name as RelatedCompany,
        companyRelated.Oid as RelatedCompanyId,
		country.Name as Country,
		city.Name as City
from	Supplier s 
            join CompanyLookup com on s.Company = com.Id
            left join Division d on s.Division = d.Oid
            left join Department dp on s.Department = dp.Oid
            left join Department depRelated on s.RelatedDepartment = depRelated.Oid
            left join Company companyRelated on s.RelatedCompany = companyRelated.Oid
            left join Currency cr on cr.Oid = s.Currency
            left join Vat v on v.Oid = s.Vat
            left join PaymentCondition pc on s.PaymentCondition = pc.Oid
            left join UserLookup createdBy on s.CreatedBy = createdBy.Id
            left join UserLookup modifiedBy on s.ModifiedBy = modifiedBy.Id
            left join Country country on s.SupplierCountry = country.Oid
            left join City city on s.SupplierCity = city.Oid
